title: CSS Animations: Performance Best Practices
content:
# CSS Animations: Performance Best Practices

## The Golden Rule

Always animate **transform** and **opacity** properties only. These are GPU-accelerated and won't trigger layout recalculations.

## What to Avoid
- Animating `width`, `height`, `top`, `left` — triggers layout
- Animating `box-shadow` — triggers paint
- Animating `filter` on large elements — expensive

## Techniques
- Use `will-change` sparingly
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Use `content-visibility` for offscreen content
- Leverage CSS `contain` property
